status: Canonical generic source/window concept with unchanged SGF qualitative example

generic_scheme.availability: Schematic source categories. Not every generator contains every source. This is not a new retrieval module.
generic_scheme.denoising: Base denoising policy unchanged. Historical-source arrows show availability under that policy, not mandatory access to all classes at every denoising step.
generic_scheme.selection: Direct committing context is current clean block plus genuine recent original-trajectory KV. Sink and other nonrecent sources are excluded from direct committing access.
generic_scheme.window: w includes current c latent frames. Blue bracket selects w-c historical frames. Six glyphs and the selected suffix are schematic, not universal budgets or physical cache capacity.
generic_scheme.construction: Current K/V is computed by the committing forward. New KV is not a copy of the selected history.
generic_scheme.indirect_history: Current latent and recent KV can retain older historical influence.
generic_scheme.illustrations: Editable source-role illustrations are not measured KV tensors or experimental frames.

sgf_instance: Base SGF committing uses 3 sink + 6 recent + 3 current frames. Commit Forcing uses 6 recent + 3 current, total w=9. Sink remains stored and the denoising policy is unchanged. SGF is not attributed slow memory or replay modules.
display: Two original full-frame PNGs remain unchanged and are embedded byte-for-byte at the prior geometry. Normal vector-PDF export may resample image objects. No crop, retouching, or new case.
rng: Shared prompt and initial-noise seed; no claim of identical intermediate stochastic streams.
